'''Operation New Eclipse''' was the name of a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] operation undertaken in order to eliminate a minefield blockade of the [[Impossible Sector]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron was dispatched to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to destroy the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who were maintaining the blockade and preventing Republic-allied [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] from delivering vital supplies to the Republic.
